description.p: FastProcMan is a light and fast process manager. List what is running, sort by CPU or memory, filter by name, spot suspicious processes and quit or force quit one in a click. A second tab graphs CPU, memory, network and disk activity.

ul.li: A File systems tab showing mounted disks, USB drives, and network shares with size and usage.
End and Force quit with child processes, plus clearer feedback if only some processes were ended.
Better slowdown warnings that group busy workers under the build or job causing high CPU use.
Intel GPU graphs, per-core CPU load, and memory and swap usage pies.
Improved service status handling and larger size units, including TB.
Release workflows that run CI on version tags before publishing.
Quit/Force quit can also end the process's children, so a runaway job leaves no orphans.
The slowdown warning blames the job as a whole, not one of its workers, and warns when the CPU is saturated.
The Graphs page now supports Intel GPUs, shows each core's load and has memory and swap pies.
The slowdown warning now blames a whole build (such as cargo and its rustc workers) instead of each worker, including builds started by tools without job control.
The warning shows how many workers are grouped, and highlights them in the list.
The Flatpak now uses the Freedesktop 26.08 runtime.
